subject: Build Error when deploying to ShinyApps.io

messages.author: d2a811d5f6f85796
messages.subject: Build Error when deploying to ShinyApps.io
parts:
Hi, 

My shiny app works locally. When I try to deploy my app, I get:
Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 582229 failed: Error building image: Error building nloptr (1.0.0). Build exited with non-zero status: 1

Any ideas of what could be wrong?
Thank you for your help

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Re: Build Error when deploying to ShinyApps.io
parts:
Hi,

This likely isn't working because the nloptr requires the nlopt library to installed on our servers, but we currently don't install it. We can probably add support for this in the future.

-Andy
